I'll investigate this in parallel — fetching the job log from AAP2 and searching for the catalog item at the same time.The job log is clear. The catalog item didn't come up under "vector-tile-server" — let me try alternate names based on what the job shows.Everything is now confirmed. Here is the full picture:

---

## What AWS Rejected

AWS rejected the CloudFormation stack with a **400 InvalidRequest** error:

> *"The architecture 'arm64' of the specified instance type does not match the architecture 'x86_64' of the specified AMI."*

The job attempted to launch **`c7g.2xlarge`** (AWS Graviton3, **arm64**) against a lab AMI that is built for **x86_64** only. The two architectures are incompatible; CloudFormation rolled the stack back immediately (`ROLLBACK_COMPLETE`).

---

## Why the Catalog Change Did Not Take Effect

The teammate's change on 2026-10-12 — setting `worker_instance_type: c7i.2xlarge` — **is in the file**, but the file also contains a **second, duplicate key** further down that overrides it:

```yaml
# geo_bu/tile-server-lab/common.yaml

# Worker sizing (the lab image is built for x86_64 only)
worker_instance_count: 2
worker_instance_type: c7i.2xlarge          # ← line ~14: teammate's change
...

# Cheaper workers, from the 2026-07 cost review
worker_instance_type: c7g.2xlarge          # ← line ~27: stale duplicate, WINS
```

YAML **does not reject duplicate keys** — the last occurrence wins. So every provision, regardless of any cache state, will always use `c7g.2xlarge` until the duplicate is removed. This is **not** a stale project cache on the controller; syncing the project would make no difference.

---

## Offending Line Citation

```
rhpds/agnosticv:geo_bu/tile-server-lab/common.yaml:27
```

```yaml
worker_instance_type: c7g.2xlarge
```

---

## What to Change

**Delete the duplicate `worker_instance_type: c7g.2xlarge` line** (line ~27, under the `# Cheaper workers` comment). The earlier declaration of `c7i.2xlarge` (line ~14) is the correct value and will then take effect cleanly. The comment block that introduced `c7g.2xlarge` in the July 2026 cost review should also be removed or updated to avoid confusion.

No project re-sync or job relaunch is needed until this YAML fix is merged — relaunching against the current file will produce the same arm64/x86_64 mismatch failure.

---
